title: Eightball AI Vision Ball Detections
description: Validates the raw array emitted by the vision provider. Uniqueness of id and table-bound checks are enforced by the core validator.

id.description: Vision-provided identifier. Its meaning is not assumed to be cue-ball, solid, stripe, or canonical ball number.

x.description: X coordinate in millimeters, measured in the provisional table-centered coordinate frame.

y.description: Y coordinate in millimeters, measured in the provisional table-centered coordinate frame.

confidence.description: Optional vision confidence in the inclusive range [0, 1].
